content_units: High-Protein Budget Shop Verdict

For   one adult meal-prepping 5 lunches and 4 dinners  ,   Store A is the best overall choice  . It balances   cost, protein quality, and practical package sizes   without the compromises attached to Stores B and C.
-   Best overall:     Store A — $48.70
-   Best pure lowest price:   Store C — $46.90
-   Best only if you know you will use extra yogurt/chicken:   Store B — $52.10
Store-by-Store Value Comparison
Store   Total   Protein Value   Practicality for 1 Adult   Main Trade-off   Verdict
Store A   $48.70   Strong across eggs, yogurt, chicken, beans, peanut butter   Very good; no noted sizing/quality issues   Not the absolute cheapest     Best overall

Store B   $52.10   Very strong; larger yogurt and cheaper chicken per kg improve protein economics   Good if you reliably finish larger packs   Higher upfront spend; possible excess for one person   Best bulk-value alternative

Store C   $46.90   Good on paper, but weaker due to lower-grade eggs and smaller frozen veg   Fair, but may need earlier top-up on vegetables   Quality compromise and less veg coverage   Best only for strict lowest checkout total
Why Store A Wins for Your Goal
You want   high protein + tight budget + realistic meal prep  . Store A fits that best because:
- It is only   $1.80 more than Store C  , which is a very small premium to avoid the weaker egg quality and smaller frozen veg pack.
- It is   $3.40 cheaper than Store B  , which matters on a tight weekly budget.
- It avoids the risk of   buying oversized dairy/bulk meat   that may be less convenient for one person unless you are very consistent with intake.
- Your basket already has multiple protein anchors:   eggs, Greek yogurt, chicken breast, beans, peanut butter  . So consistency and usable portions matter as much as sticker price.
Best Fit for 5 Lunches and 4 Dinners
For 9 prepared main meals, this basket supports a practical rotation like:
Option 1: Chicken + rice + frozen vegetables bowls   Best lunch base with strong protein and easy batch cooking   Highest practicality
Plan meals
Option 2: Bean, rice, and egg bowls   Cheap backup dinners with good satiety   Best budget extender
Budget nutrition
Option 3: Oats + Greek yogurt + banana + peanut butter   High-protein breakfast/snack support   Improves total weekly protein intake
Protein guide
Best Choice by Shopping Priority
-   Choose Store A   if you want the   best overall weekly pick  .
-   Choose Store B   if you are comfortable paying more upfront for   better bulk protein economics  , especially if you eat a lot of yogurt and chicken every week.
-   Choose Store C   only if   minimizing checkout total   matters more than egg quality and vegetable quantity.
